cards.issue_title: Homepage story full-screen slides need consolidation
summary_4_lines: The homepage story is a stack of full-screen slides.
They said “Transparent, like never before” does not deserve a whole slide, because nothing else is on it.
They counted six unique points and asked to refactor the story into fewer slides — two, then three, then the last — without making the homepage longer.
The named goal of this stretch is consolidation: cut sections, keep the new facts.
cards.pinpoint: On the Shroffin homepage story, they treated the full-screen slides as too many and too thin: transparency is self-explanatory and should not be an entire slide; zero commission / zero bias is already said; six unique points should be refactored into fewer slides so the homepage does not get longer.
cards.on_screen_object: Homepage story full-screen slides (Transparent like never before; Zero commissions / Zero bias; Best of all / own pace / no spam)
quotes_sample: Okay, we are transparent, but I don't think we should do an entire slide.
Zero commission, zero bias. We have already said this.
The goal of entire activity is consolidation
related_discussion_one_liners: Transparent-slide extra sentence (“So you find what works for you with no surprises” / “You don't have to add anything”) and “Now we are talking about a story.”
New-vs-already-said: spam vs hard sell vs notifications vs not giving a phone number; “Who is going to call you?” / pick banks / apply once; “Look at the net” (ASR, likely “Look at that”).
Four texts as a concern with transparent in the middle; first half not unique; second half can be accommodated; putting everything in one place becomes heavy so it is not a separate section.
Analogy of four sections vs six points — how many sections to divide, minimum words per point, which points go together, and “Whatever you are making, we have to increase it. We have to reduce it.”

After the plan: they like font, color guide, sections and spacing; “I have changed my website”; used to feel something was missing while explaining; “You were at 5, I was telling you to come at 20, and you got me at 60” (praise, not the issue).
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the story architecture ask (too many thin full-screen slides; six unique points grouped into fewer slides without lengthening the homepage), not the Zero scroll-fade, not the Built-around-you accordion one-line read, and not the side-preview duplicate.

cards.issue_title: Homepage story section fading on scroll
summary_4_lines: While still on the homepage story, they said the color is not white, then that the color is not there.
They said the whole section is fading away, and that it was not like that from the start.
They repeated that three times, then said they think this section should be removed.
The frame at that moment shows the Zero slide with the body color gone, leaving two stacked “Zero” words.
cards.pinpoint: On the homepage story, they said the section’s color is gone and the whole section is fading away — not like that from the start — and they think this section should be removed; the matching shot shows two stacked Zero words with the rest of the slide faded out.
cards.on_screen_object: Homepage story full-screen section (Zero commissions / Zero bias) as it fades on scroll
quotes_sample: The whole section is fading away.
From the start, it was not like that.
related_discussion_one_liners: Immediately before: they like font, color guide, sections and spacing, plus the 5/20/60 missing-something talk — that praise is issue-01 related talk, not this fade.
“It is nice” after “the color is not white” is about the remaining color, not approval of the fade.
After this they leave the story and attack Built around you (issues 03–04); “Remove this section” here is still the fading story block, not yet the accordion.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the live scroll fade of the Zero story section (color gone, stacked “Zero” words, unlike from the start), not the consolidation of too many slides and not the later Built-around-you accordion or side-preview problems.

cards.issue_title: Built around you accordion shows one line
summary_4_lines: They reached “Built around you.” and said the control is not opening.
They said they see one line, have to read more, and see only one point on one screen.
They clicked the accordion rows; the panel still shows one expanded heading plus a short line, not a full open read.
They said maybe this section should be removed.
cards.pinpoint: On the homepage Built around you accordion, they said it is not opening: they see one line / only one point on one screen and have to read more, so they cannot read the points unless a single row is expanded.
quotes_sample: It is not opening up. I see one line.
I see only one point on one screen
Maybe we should remove this section. It would be unique.
related_discussion_one_liners: “Remove the voice chat and fit it” is ASR; joined to this accordion, not a missing chat product.

They weigh dropping Built around you because it does not read, while still calling the content unique (“Maybe we should remove this section. It would be unique.”); removal talk is related, the defect is the one-line accordion.
Side preview (Guides / Before-While-After card) is issue 04, not this.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the left accordion not opening into a readable set (one line / one point per screen, extra clicks to read), not the story-slide consolidation, not the Zero scroll-fade, and not the right-hand preview duplicating the same copy.

cards.issue_title: Built around you side preview is a duplicate
summary_4_lines: Beside the Built around you accordion they pointed at a card that repeats the same Guides steps.
They said it is not in the phone, it sits below the dropdown, and it is just a duplicate.
They called that pattern cheap: many companies do it; Apple does not; even if kept, it is not normal.
At the end they asked, when comparing, what is written on top versus what is actually seen.
cards.pinpoint: The card to the right of the Built around you accordion duplicates the accordion copy (Guides steps / same-layout table) instead of showing a real product; they called it a duplicate, cheap, not what Apple does, and asked what the difference is when comparing because it is written on top but not seen on top.
cards.on_screen_object: Built around you right-hand preview card (Guides Before/While/After; Same layout table)
quotes_sample: It is cheap. Many companies do it. I have seen it. Apple doesn't do it.
But it is written on the top. It is not seen on the top. What is the difference?
related_discussion_one_liners: Apple vs “many companies” as the taste test for this dual-column preview; they said it is not normal.
“We should put it here and it will scroll” — they sketched moving the content rather than keeping a side duplicate (related, not a second issue).
“I don't know how to do it / I can't do it” is them stuck on the pattern, not a new site bug.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the right-hand preview card repeating accordion copy (Guides steps / toy same-layout table) instead of the real product, not the accordion’s one-line open and not the homepage-story slide or fade issues.
